repos.name: jingyaogong/minimind
repos.description: 🧠 Train a 64M-parameter LLM from scratch in just 2h!
repos.one_liner: A highly efficient, educational framework for training a 64M-parameter LLM from scratch in under two hours.
bullets: Built with PyTorch, focusing on lightweight architecture and optimized training loops.
Demonstrates the full lifecycle of LLM development, from tokenization to pre-training and fine-tuning.
Ideal for researchers and developers looking to understand the mechanics of transformer models without massive compute requirements.
Provides a practical baseline for experimenting with model distillation and parameter-efficient training.

repos.name: mosonlab/anneal
repos.description: You write the specs. It clears the board: coding agent chains plan, review, implement, verify and merge unattended on your own machine, on the Codex and Claude subscriptions you already have.
repos.one_liner: An autonomous coding agent framework that orchestrates chains to plan, implement, and verify code changes locally.
bullets: Utilizes existing Claude and Codex subscriptions to power agentic workflows.
Features a multi-step pipeline: planning, implementation, review, and automated verification.
Designed for local execution, ensuring code privacy and direct integration with local development environments.
Automates the full software development lifecycle (SDLC) for routine tasks and refactoring.

repos.name: Osmantic/ODS
repos.description: Turn your PC, Mac, or Linux box into an AI server.  LLM inference, chat UI, voice, agents, workflows, RAG, and image generation.

bullets: Supports a full stack of AI capabilities including RAG, voice processing, and image generation.

Enables secure, offline deployment of LLMs, critical for enterprise data privacy and compliance.
Simplifies the infrastructure overhead of hosting multiple AI services on consumer-grade hardware.
